content: अतिशयः [शी-अच्] .²1 Excess, pre-eminence, excellence; वीर्य˚ <ls>R. 3. 62</ls>; महिम्नां … अतिशयः <ls>U. 4. 21</ls>; तस्मिन् विधानातिशये विधातुः <ls>R. 6. 11</ls> excellence, highest perfection of art. .²2 Superiority (in quality, rank, quantity <ab>&c.</ab>); महार्घस्तीर्थानामिव हि महतां कोऽप्यतिशयः <ls>U. 6. 11</ls>; often in <ab>comp.</ab> with adjectives, in the sense of ‘exceedingly’; ˚रमणीयः <ls>Mu. 3</ls>; आसीदतिशयप्रेक्ष्यः <ls>R. 17. 25</ls>; मुक्ता गुणातिशयसंभृतमण्डनश्रीः <ls>V. 5. 19</ls>; or with nouns, meaning ‘excellent’; ‘excessive’; ‘very great’; ˚रयः, अश्वातिशयम <ls>K. 80</ls> the best of horses; ˚दारिद्र्योपहताः. .²3 Advantageous result, one of the superhuman qualities attributed to Jain saints. --{%a.%} [अतिशयः अस्त्यर्थे अच्] Superior, pre-eminent, excessive, very great, abundant.
